continuityMode.requirement: Copy source vehId to private vehicle_observation.vehicle_id using the same scalar-to-text representation as the current live collector.

boundary.acceptance: For each route, aggregate the shared vehicle_id count across its 30-minute source/live windows without returning any value, require the exact current route version ID, and report source-last versus target-first independently.

continuityMode.sensitiveHandling: Trainer may use vehicle_id only inside the private transaction. Values never appear in model artifacts, feature exports, logs, fixtures, receipts, or stdout.

causalAsOfRules.name: trajectory
causalAsOfRules.rule: Read every batch, including empty batches, in the 30-minute window ending at the prediction cursor; do not pre-filter gaps in SQL.

causalAsOfRules.name: arrival label
causalAsOfRules.rule: Candidate observations must be strictly after the prediction instant, in order, for the same private vehicle_id and the same current route version; apply the versioned gap and sequence-jump censoring rules.

causalAsOfRules.name: stop demand statistics
causalAsOfRules.rule: Choose only a statistics generation with data_until <= the prediction observation instant. Capacity observations and settled labels used to build that generation must also be bounded by its data_until.
causalAsOfRules.currentRuntimeAlignment: V11 and JdbcStopDemandStatisticsRepository implement generation history and as-of selection.

causalAsOfRules.name: route roster
causalAsOfRules.rule: Resolve route_version by the observation instant and bind every stop_order/stop_id pair to that version before building route position or boarding features.
